name: hitch
description: Other agent harnesses (Codex, Cursor, Amp, pi, Devin) as native Claude Code subagents: they show in the agent list, stop, notify and take follow-ups like any subagent, and no Claude request is made for their work.

codexEnabled.title: Codex enabled
codexEnabled.description: Off leaves hitch:codex unregistered as an agent type.

codexPath.title: Codex executable path
codexPath.description: Absolute path to the Codex CLI (~ allowed). Empty: look on PATH, then in a login shell for desktop app sessions.

codexModel.title: Codex model
codexModel.description: The model hitch:codex runs (codex exec -m). Always passed: the Agent tool's model parameter only takes Claude aliases.

codexSandbox.title: Codex sandbox
codexSandbox.description: Deprecated for one release: use codexAccess. Only non-default legacy values override follow.

codexIdleTimeoutSec.title: Codex idle timeout (seconds)
codexIdleTimeoutSec.description: If Codex writes nothing for this long while it waits on its model (no command running), it is stopped and the turn ends with a failure that says the thread can be continued with SendMessage.

codexCommandTimeoutSec.title: Codex command timeout (seconds)
codexCommandTimeoutSec.description: The longest a single command or tool Codex runs may take before Codex is stopped. The idle timeout does not count while a command runs.

cursorEnabled.title: Cursor enabled
cursorEnabled.description: Off leaves hitch:cursor unregistered as an agent type.

cursorPath.title: Cursor executable path
cursorPath.description: Absolute path to the Cursor CLI (~ allowed). Empty: look on PATH, then in a login shell for desktop app sessions.

cursorModel.title: Cursor model
cursorModel.description: The model hitch:cursor runs (agent --model). Always passed: the Agent tool's model parameter only takes Claude aliases. Cursor encodes effort in model names, so the call's effort is not mapped.

cursorSandbox.title: Cursor sandbox
cursorSandbox.description: Deprecated for one release: use cursorAccess. Only non-default legacy values override follow.

cursorIdleTimeoutSec.title: Cursor idle timeout (seconds)
cursorIdleTimeoutSec.description: If Cursor writes nothing for this long while it waits on its model (no command running), it is stopped and the turn ends with a failure that says the session can be continued with SendMessage.

cursorCommandTimeoutSec.title: Cursor command timeout (seconds)
cursorCommandTimeoutSec.description: The longest a single command or tool Cursor runs may take before Cursor is stopped. The idle timeout does not count while a command runs.

piEnabled.title: pi enabled
piEnabled.description: Off leaves hitch:pi unregistered as an agent type.

piPath.title: pi executable path
piPath.description: Absolute path to the pi CLI (~ allowed). Empty: look on PATH, then in a login shell for desktop app sessions.

piModel.title: pi model
piModel.description: The provider/model pi runs, split at the first slash into --provider and --model. The Agent model parameter does not apply.

piSandbox.title: pi sandbox
piSandbox.description: Deprecated for one release: use piAccess. Only non-default legacy values override follow.

piIdleTimeoutSec.title: pi idle timeout (seconds)
piIdleTimeoutSec.description: If pi writes nothing for this long while it waits on its model (no command running), it is stopped and the turn ends with a failure that says the thread can be continued with SendMessage.

piCommandTimeoutSec.title: pi command timeout (seconds)
piCommandTimeoutSec.description: The longest a single command or tool pi runs may take before pi is stopped. The idle timeout does not count while a command runs.

ampEnabled.title: Amp enabled
ampEnabled.description: Off leaves hitch:amp unregistered as an agent type.

ampPath.title: Amp executable path
ampPath.description: Absolute path to the Amp CLI (~ allowed). Empty: look on PATH, then in a login shell for desktop app sessions.

ampModel.title: Amp agent mode
ampModel.description: The Amp agent mode (amp -m), not a model name. Agent effort overrides this mode; xhigh and max select ultra.

ampIdleTimeoutSec.title: Amp idle timeout (seconds)
ampIdleTimeoutSec.description: If Amp writes nothing for this long while it waits on its model (no command running), it is stopped and the turn ends with a failure that says the thread can be continued with SendMessage.

ampCommandTimeoutSec.title: Amp command timeout (seconds)
ampCommandTimeoutSec.description: The longest a single command or tool Amp runs may take before Amp is stopped. The idle timeout does not count while a command runs.

devinEnabled.title: Devin enabled
devinEnabled.description: Off leaves hitch:devin unregistered as an agent type.

devinPath.title: Devin executable path
devinPath.description: Absolute path to the Devin CLI (~ allowed). Empty: look on PATH, then in a login shell for desktop app sessions.

devinModel.title: Devin model
devinModel.description: The model hitch:devin runs (devin --model). Always passed: the Agent tool's model parameter only takes Claude aliases. The free swe-2(-flash)-(medium|high|max) names take the call's effort as their suffix.

devinSandbox.title: Devin sandbox
devinSandbox.description: Deprecated for one release: use devinAccess. Only non-default legacy values override follow.

devinIdleTimeoutSec.title: Devin idle timeout (seconds)
devinIdleTimeoutSec.description: If Devin sends nothing for this long while it waits on its model (no tool running), it is stopped and the turn ends with a failure that says the session can be continued with SendMessage.

devinCommandTimeoutSec.title: Devin command timeout (seconds)
devinCommandTimeoutSec.description: The longest a single command or tool Devin runs may take before Devin is stopped.

devinTransport.title: Devin transport
devinTransport.description: acp: drive `devin acp` (messages, a HitchLog row per tool call and permission, follow-ups continue the session). cli-text: the older `devin -p` print mode (plain text, no rows, no follow-ups).

hideRowTool.title: Hide the row tool from other agents
hideRowTool.description: On by default: hitch registers two hooks that keep its display-only HitchLog tool out of other agents' tool lists. Where Claude Code's managed security mod (sec-default) runs first, those hooks never run and Claude Code prints two "hook was skipped" lines per session; turn this off there to drop the lines. Nothing else changes on such a machine.

stampHarnessModel.title: Stamp the harness model on steps
stampHarnessModel.description: Experimental. Each step reports all-zero usage naming the harness model (codex/<model>) instead of no usage, so transcript rows may name it in place of the placeholder Claude model.

delegationLog.title: Delegation log
delegationLog.description: A JSON line per finished harness turn (no prompt or report text) is appended here; ~/ is your home folder. /hitch log summarizes it.

reviewer.title: Reviewer harness
reviewer.description: A harness key (codex, cursor, amp, pi or devin) whose agent description then says it is the user's chosen harness for second opinions and reviews. Empty, off or unknown: no reviewer.

builder.title: Builder harness
builder.description: A harness key (codex, cursor, amp, pi or devin) whose agent description then says it is the user's chosen harness for well-specified builds. Empty, off or unknown: no builder.

eagerness.title: Delegation eagerness
eagerness.description: How eagerly Claude hands work to a harness, stated in every agent description: ask-only (default), rubric, or eager.

codexAccess.title: codex access
codexAccess.description: follow: respect session mode and permissions. Explicit supported levels are standing consent; plan always requires read-only.
